name: Raleway
summary: Sans-serif family with 9 weights plus italics, variable on a 100-900 weight axis, free to download and embed.
description: Raleway is a sans-serif typeface family by Matt McInerney, Pablo Impallari and Rodrigo Fuenzalida, grown from a single thin weight into a 9 weight family with italics. It ships old style and lining numerals, standard and discretionary ligatures and a stylistic alternate, and covers Latin, Latin Extended, Cyrillic and Vietnamese. Free under the SIL Open Font License.
contains: weights 100-900 plus italics as one variable font (wght axis)
subsets: latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext, vietnamese
old style and lining numerals, standard and discretionary ligatures
designers: Matt McInerney, Pablo Impallari, Rodrigo Fuenzalida
